pool_frame.ordinary_c_frame: Four dword-word pointers for starts and ends; cursor word0 unsigned size/flags, allocated word1 caller output-slot address. A four-byte union PoolWord { unsigned long descriptor; void **owner_slot; } supports ordinary word-stride traversal without inventing fixed block sizes.

block_descriptor.low30_bits: Total dword count including2 header words for allocated blocks.
block_descriptor.bit30: Pinned/retained flag0x40000000 set by allocationflag0x10; bulk_free and compact honor it.
block_descriptor.allocated_word1: Owner pointer-slot address, not another block pointer.
block_descriptor.free_blocks: Traversal needs only word0; residual free block can have one word, so do not require a two-word header read on every free block.

initialization.save: 1ff0 zeroes default sharedstate and arena from interfacecells then2028 calls4450 to save arena+size;2043 calls10690;106b3 calls4510 with savedarena/savedbytes/pool0.
initialization.initialize_formula: N=(arena_bytes>>2)-2; starts[id]=arena; ends[id]=arena+4*N; arena_word0=N|FREE. Starting atword2, store1 forN-1 consecutive words, including wordN at end marker; no initialization of word1.
initialization.conditions: Unsigned shift/subtract and decrement loop have no small-arena guard. Preserve observed behavior; do not add checks.

allocation.signature_scope: Three caller-cleaned dword arguments: output-slot address, requested byte count, flags. EAX allocated pointer orNULL. Exact original typedef/prototype names unknown.
allocation.request_rounding: need_words=((requested_bytes+3)>>2)+2 using unsigned32 wraparound; payloadmetadata bytes=4*need_words-8. No overflow or zero-request guard observed.
allocation.selection: Scan all blocks from starts[flags&3] to ends[flags&3], advancing by word0&0x3fffffff. Replace selected pointer/wordcount for every free block with size>=need_words; therefore LAST fitting block in address order.
allocation.split: remaining_words=chosen_words-need_words. Equal size: use selected block, write descriptor flags|need_words and owner word1. Larger: leave FREE|remaining_words at old base; write allocated descriptor and owner at base+4*remaining_words. Return allocated header+8.

flags.preserve_output_on_failure: flags0x20 leaves existing owner-slot contents alone; otherwise writeNULL through output slot.

allocation.preexisting_output: Read initial *output and issue diagnostic call if nonnull; there is no automatic free/realloc before allocation.
allocation.success: Store resulting payload through original outputslot at4667, return same pointer inEAX.
allocation.failure: No selected block: optionally clear outputslot (flags0x20 control), returnNULL.

lifecycle.free: 4750 acceptsNULL as no-op; finds pool by start<payload<end among4slots; sets FREE bit atpayload-8, calls4830 coalesce, reads owner frompayload-4 and clears it ifnonnull. Out-of-pool pointer returns without mutation.
lifecycle.coalesce: 4830 traverses selected pool; when current and successor word0 have FREE, adds masked successor wordcount to current descriptor and repeats without advancing. Otherwise advances by current descriptor*4; that scale discards high flag bits modulo32.
lifecycle.bulk_free: 47c0 snapshots poolfirstheader/size; traverses blocks and frees only descriptor with neitherFREE norPINNED whose owner-slot content is nonzero; then4890 compacts.
lifecycle.compact: 48a0 walks used blocks in reverse ordinal order; pinned prevents movement. If following block isfree, copies current block upward into higher address via43a0, updates owner-slot to moved payload, leaves residual free header and coalesces. No fixed extent or source declaration claim.
lifecycle.shrink: 4690 can relocate payload upward when shrinking, preserving pinned flag and owner; optional header-only versus full block copy path. Calls10fb0 copy helper and4830; its library/source identity unresolved.
